```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
```

To practice data manipulation in R, we'll be exploring the flights dataset
consisting of all the flights that departed from NYC in 2013.

Wickham, H. (2014). nycflights13: Flights that Departed NYC in 2013.
https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=nycflights13

# Problem 1

Read in the data.

```{r}
flights_df = read.csv("flights.csv")
```

# Problem 2

Obtain the descriptive statistics of the data.

```{r}
summary(flights_df)
```

# Problem 3

How many flights departed from NYC between June and July of 2013?
Hint: the `n()` function is a useful summary function that returns the number
of observations in a data frame.

```{r}
flights_df %>%
  filter(month == 6 | month == 7) %>%
  summarize(n_flights = n())

# solution: 57,668 flights
```

# Problem 4

Which three carriers had the highest average departure delays?

```{r}
flights_df %>%
  select(carrier, dep_delay) %>%
  group_by(carrier) %>%
  summarize(avg_dep_delay = mean(dep_delay, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(desc(avg_dep_delay)) %>%
  head(3)

# solution: F9, EV, YV
```

# Problem 5

Which destination airport corresponded to the longest flights on average for
flights departing from JFK airport?

```{r}
flights_df %>%
  filter(origin == "JFK") %>%
  select(dest, air_time) %>%
  group_by(dest) %>%
  summarize(avg_air_time = mean(air_time, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(desc(avg_air_time)) %>%
  head(1)

# solution: HNL
```

How far is this destination airport from JFK airport?

```{r}
flights_df %>%
  filter(origin == "JFK", dest == "HNL") %>%
  select(origin, dest, distance) %>%
  head(1)

# solution: 4,983 miles
```

# Problem 6

What was the busiest day of the year for travel (i.e., the day corresponding to
the highest number of flights)?

```{r}
flights_df %>%
  group_by(month, day) %>%
  summarize(n_flights = n()) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_flights)) %>%
  head(1)

# solution: November 27
```

# Problem 7

Create a binary variable that corresponds to 1 if the arrival delay exceeded one
hour and 0 otherwise.

```{r}
flights_df =
  flights_df %>%
  mutate(arr_delay_1hr = ifelse(arr_delay > 60, 1, 0))
```
